name: Lvgl → On Boot
description: This [trigger](https://esphome.io/components/lvgl/widgets/#triggers) is triggered after LVGL has been setup. It is available on the `lvgl` component and any widget and can be used to perform any LVGL related setup that is not possible with static configuration. When used on a widget, it does not act specifically on that widget but can be used to keep actions related to that widget together with its configuration.
